notes.title: Good News for the game!
notes.content:
Hi there! I have an announcement I wanna share here on Steam! Just a few days ago I shared this on twitter but I figured people here need to know as well.


So to be clear I have made the decision of translating the game into 4 more languages to connect better with players and make a more enjoyable experience for players from these regions who prefer to use them in game.

[i]
The languages are the following: [/i]

[list]
[b][*] Latin American Spanish 
[*] Russian
[*]Mandarin (Chinese)
[*]As well as Brazilian Portuguese [/b]
[/list]  


[i]Why these languages specifically?[/i]
 These are based on the current statistics of origins on wishlists for the game. My hope with this will bring some appreciation for future players of the games from these regions thank you! And thanks to everyone who has taken their time to do just a little bit to support the game! Right now I am planning to release this update later on for the demo when the game is getting closer to release date (Arround June/July). So we don't have to translate stuff bit by bit which would be tiresome. 


This is all from me now. Just a quick announcement but you can be sure more is to come featuring more game update info next time! Stay tuned:)

/Isac - developer of Corrupted

notes.title: Demo Update #2 is here!
notes.content:
Hi everyone and welcome back to a brand new update for the demo! 

In this article we will take a look at the brand new enemy "Archanoid Steel" or the robot spider which more people probably recognizes it as. But also the new interesting mechanics such as the taming mechanic and the fast traveling mechanic!

[i]Let's dive right in:[/i]


[b]Archanoid Steel (The robot spider)[/b]

This is probably the most frightening thing created yet in this game! With it's scary movements and sudden suprise attacks in the sewer area it will surely give a bit of a scary vibe to those maps!
The thing with these creatures is that they actaully invincible, but not only that they are also the first tameable creatures! More on that later.

So little is known about these guys in general. Some seems to think they are a product of the regime, designed to threaten the resitance group and their activites in the sewer area. Maybe the regime doesn't know exactly where the resitance camp is located but have heard about the rumors that they are hiding somewhere underground?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939235/367b5b534bed821d56940f28b29a0b0e62e5b3c3.png[/img]




Next what about the taming mechanic? How is this new feature going to work and how is it implemented? [i]Let's take a look![/i]



[b]The Taming Mechanic[/b]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939235/b09bb511a197893b514856ad9c529b5cc3dc1572.png[/img]

I have ever since I was a little kid playing on the playgrounds at school loved the idea of having a pet. Especially in an RPG setting! How cool isn't it to have a little guy by your side helping you out? Or well..urm maybe not this creature is as little as what we imagine when we think of a pet. 

To start off your taming journey you go go the mechanic guy in the first slum area. They will give you item's that originally he was given by the physcian. And they are willing to offer you those for free. He prefers staying inside and create things in his own comfortable heated home. Not lurking arround underground in those cold tunnels brrrr...

After accepting these. You will head down to the sewers area and hope you find a spider yourself. It can take a bit of time it is completly random where they spawn afterall. 

And when you have found one of these beasts. Or cuties however you prefer. You will do your classic monster tamer task of battling with it until the creature has reached a low level of HP so you can have a good chance of taming it!




Pet's themselves are not like usual character's though. You don't just spawn with them. You need to use the button which sends it out and it replaces on character already on your party in battle. Meaning if you have two character's out Tommy or Alvin will be replaced for example. After the pet has died it will be replaced with a character. I am working on adding an improvement regarding this in the future where you can switch out your pet and prefered choice of character whenever you want. Obviously the drawback if you choose to switch out often is that it takes a turn. I do belive this will create better and more creative way of replacing character's because you have more options. 


Like normal character's they level up of course, and they are interesting additions to the battle system.


[b]Fast traveling[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939235/332a75d545c48ab16a3acfc1e8f162bd165e9b3c.png[/img]

After choosing the camp you want to go to. A quick loading screen will appear which I have carefully designed with a futursitic aesthetic.[/i]



Fast traveling is an important feature. that has now finally been added and will make traveling much more pleasent and effecient. To limit this feature in order to not make it an easy overpowered cheat which would remove all the points of having maps. I have locked it only to the key resitance camps that are located across various parts of Valborg. All the way from the secret sewer camp to the church (Not available in Demo) and also the place located in the city called Full Moon Bar. 


You will of course only be able to travel to these destinations if you have already visited them previously. 



Lastly I want to as always thank you for reading this extensive breakdown but also mention that I have made some improvements to make the first enemies you meet a bit easier. Which many has given me feedback for! I am hoping it was interesting and sparked a bit of curiosity. And see you in the next on post!

notes.title: Corrupted Demo Update #1 is here!!
notes.content:
Hi everyone and welcome to the first update for the demo! I hope you are enjoying your adventures so far!


This update focuses on improving many widespread things for the whole demo experience. Including better light in the sewers, making the first boss fight a bit more balanced, a newly added side quest including a new interior map, and creating a smarter enemy AI!
Let's take a look at it all shall we?:)





[b]Sewers Area[/b]
Many people have expressed their love for this particular part of the demo with it's funky music and puzzles. There was however some concerns over that it was hard to navigate through for the first time. As a developer it is important for me to take this feedback seriously so I came up with the start of some changes including these things:

[list]
[*] Cutscenes that details the place where the bridge will appear. Adding dialogue can be a easy way of making things more clear. I also created one specifically for when you have completed the two tasks you will need in order for it to appear (Which is toggling the handle and completing the puzzle to toggle the second handle) Which shows simply that the  bridge is now there ready for you to walk on!
[*] Some also expressed some concern over that it felt overwhelming with the big sewer depths area having two puzles in a row so for that I decided to remove the second one of these. Afterall I understand all players do not enjoy puzzles that much so I think this was something that those players will appreciate.

[/list]

I am not fully done with the changes for the sewer maps yet but I am sure these changes is a great step in the right direction and I hope the players who have had some concerns can feel rest assured on this. 



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939235/6e1ec404a0cb0baa687c926834791b2e85c1dae4.png[/img]
[i]The Sewers area has been updated with new lighting for better visual appeal! Aditionally I have also made it more clear during your first time there what you should do through some small cutscenes.[/i]



[b]Boss Battle balancing[/b]


Previously it was fairly hard to succesfully beat the first couple of enemies in the very first boss battle. Even with the right items included in your pocket I could clearly sense that it felt really punishing for a first boss battle. Which some players have also mentioned. I have therefore implemented some small changes like reducing the Doctor's health with 300. But also removed one of the enemies from this battle. Which means the battle now consists of 2 Guardsmen, then one Red Guardsmen and lastly the Doctor. (Previously 3 Guardsmen at the start).
Other things I did was also placing out some chests throughout the maps! Collecting the items from these will certainly make it easier beating up your targets. 







[b]Newly added side quest[/b]



There is now a mechanic in the homeslum area close to where Alvin's house is located. He is a very skilled worker and is known as the creator of the Robot dog of the model "F1-D0". The intention with the robot was originally to protect the people living in the slums from dangerous people. That was what he thought they where going to be used as at first before he delivered them to the government. 

What ended happening was that they unfortunetly was used with an ill intention. Including scaring the people to prevent free movement in the slums. All acording to the propaganda which claims the people from the slums of being violent extremists. 

In this side quest it is your mission to defeat some of the last units walking arround in the neighborhoods and after that bring back their valuable parts back to the creator himself. 




[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939235/e0a9d22b8a157f06cfac807ed9ce367fa1187966.png[/img]
[i]If you pay close attention you might also notice that I have added a little question mark to clarify what NPCs that has a side quest waiting for you! [/i]





[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939235/24af8c64a53ee2dda44e689abf5a4f89b4c7d712.png[/img]
[i]Showcasing a battle with a robot dog! Make sure to fight it with both Alvin and Tommy in the beginning as they can be a challenging enemy in the start.[/i]






[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939235/5816e5b8a08b8506ed57398ec50ebcf1a991b7ef.png[/img]
[i]Newly added chests that surely can help you on your journey[/i]



[b]Smarter enemy AI[/b]


[list]
[*]From now on the enemies will make smarter choices. For example if they are in danger and are starting to get low on HP and have a healing attack they will use that. Or if you (their target) is getting low on HP they will most likely use an attack on that specific enemy. 
This means (hopefully) that pressing attacks without thinking will be more punished in those scenarios because it will likely be the case that you won't survive because of them using abilities that are ineffective at those times.
[*]This might not be noticeable for some but my hope is that it will bring some sort favour for those who choose to get more interested in strategic thinking. Which is my goal. 
[/list]



Yeah and the last bit of this update I wanted to just show a bit of a sneak peak into what's coming. This is art of an upcoming enemy that will be specific for the sewers area. 
Thanks so much for reading this guys and if you want to see more stuff check out my twitter/X (Corruptedgame1) or Bluesky. 😉 Let me know what you guys think down below!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939235/fbc82395bb0540202534e20230d62cef9dde66e3.png[/img]
